entities.explanation: Selected synthetic customer, not a global customer directory.
Explicit permitted recipient relationship; names do not establish family or ownership.
Reviewed ProductPackage catalogue entry; not an owned financial holding.
One current owner savings account; balances and holds remain distinct.
One credit, debit or prepaid card; only credit cards map to the Credit Card facility domain.
One fixed or recurring deposit, including explicitly historical closed deposits without double-counting principal.
One actual loan liability; disbursement, repayment schedules and purchase escrow are not free cash.
Synthetic future health/protection coverage; not automatically a P&C Policy or an approved reimbursement.
Actual bank ledger entry with separate amount and debit/credit direction.
Current customer goal or pocket, not a CDM LifeEvent and not an additional bank balance.
Current explicitly recorded customer preference; never restored from old seed values.
Available owner document descriptor only; availability does not authorize reading its contents.
Customer's actual source selection; distinct from assessment and exact execution consent.
Persisted extraction identity and metadata; historical or unselected content is withheld.
Allowlisted selected-read fact, explicit statement or retained correction, never a hidden answer key.
Already stored calculation result and provenance, not a newly run analysis or quote.
One explicitly typed persisted worksheet result, kept separate from a bank posting.
Current or explicitly retained plan, not bank authority or an execution receipt.
Requested operation with distinct current, archived and compatibility lifecycles; a proposal is not execution.
Saved filled-review projection; no refresh, requote or independent eligibility decision.
One allowlisted scalar review field; nested provider, health and source payloads are excluded.
Persisted quote under its original policy/evidence identities; inspection never renews it.
Independent persisted approve/decline/refer assessment, not a quote or an eligibility finding.
A specific evidence, assessment or execution consent; these purposes are not interchangeable.
Retained relationship-bank effect receipt; submitted compatibility instructions and saved reviews are LifecycleEvent records, not execution receipts.
Tracked servicing request, including pending investigation; no inferred resolution or reimbursement.
Actual mandate or repayment-schedule row, not a posted payment or duplicate liability.
Persisted protected-cash configuration; rule activation does not imply that a deposit was opened.
Actual nested deposit pledge; pledged principal is not counted again as owned wealth.
Actual account hold allocated to a goal; a junction record, not an extra deposit.
Recorded shared payment or purchase escrow; neither proves external rail execution nor completed conveyance.
Actually persisted relationship/effect event or explicitly instruction-only compatibility receipt, never an unapplied readiness fixture or inferred banking effect.
Pure continuity view derived from the same authorized snapshot, never a global CRM cache read or synchronization.
Owner-scoped Frontier journey state, separate from its calculations, actions and outcomes.
Deterministically detected candidate, not an outcome or executed action.
Recorded owner-scoped delegation; it is authority metadata, not another customer's record.
Consent for Frontier data or action access, kept distinct from legacy application consent.
Know-your-agent registration and bounded permissions; no bearer scopes or credentials.
Bounded surplus-to-goal mandate with explicit agent, consent and money limits.
A prepared but not necessarily approved or executed Frontier action.
Revalidated mandate execution, refusal or referral with before/after authority values.
Consent-bound transfer to a human specialist without private context payloads.
Attributable specialist disposition; explanation and private modifications are withheld.
Evidence-bound Frontier outcome; proactive fixtures cannot create it.
Sanitized attributable Frontier agent command or gateway-tool record.
Export identity/type index only, not an additional bank product.
Export edge junction only; endpoints must be real selected RecordIndex rows.
